# PassMark Software

> PassMark Software provides comprehensive PC diagnostic, benchmarking, and stress testing tools for hardware validation and performance measurement across Windows, Linux, and ARM platforms.

PassMark is a leading provider of software solutions for PC reliability testing, performance benchmarking, and hardware diagnostics. Their product suite includes PerformanceTest for CPU/GPU benchmarking, BurnInTest for stress testing and load validation, and specialized tools for USB, PCIe, WiFi, and forensic analysis.

## Key Topics

- BurnInTest
- PerformanceTest
- MemTest86
- Stress Testing
- Hardware Diagnostics
- PC Benchmarking
- USB Testing
- PCIe Test Cards
- Load Testing
- Management Console
- WiFi Monitoring
- OSForensics
- Volume Licenses
- Windows/Linux/ARM Support
- Hardware Validation
